text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay! 1st place♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-chaaaan!! That was amaziiing, 
congratulatiooons!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah...! You're seriously amazing, 
Vivlos!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup, thanks for cheering for me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Ehehe. I can hear it right beside me♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. ...It's a complete defeat 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I am frustrated, very much so. I was 
supposed to win."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that goes for everyone, doesn't 
it? You were amazing out there, 
Vivlos-san!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If we run together, I'll see what you're 
truly made of..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
With your talent, I'm certain you could 
make it on the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! Really?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's true. Go to Dubai and show them 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll definitely be back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having scored a brilliant victory in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, Vivlos parted ways with 
her family for a moment and left the 
racecourse, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Cheval-chi...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You were here?! If only you'd told me—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm spineless and cowardly. On top of 
that, I'm not honest with myself... and a 
pain to deal with.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because I had no confidence. Compared to 
my sister and you, I was just useless...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, watching you all race... ...left 
me feeling so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than looking away, it just made me 
frustrated. Even I—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm your older sister... Even 
though I should've been able to help 
you...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chi...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I've trained so much. Until I could 
proudly say that I'm your older sister."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Vivlos. Enter the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is a GⅠ race held in 
November. It is a prestigious and 
important race where top Umamusume from 
overseas also compete.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this confidence is something you 
gave me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I can lend you a hand too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —As your big sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...S-Say... something.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. Don't both make the same face!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'm okay, I'm just so happy. Because, 
because...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I made eye contact with Cheva-chi.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you care so much... just because 
I'm the older sister?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Is that not good enough as a reason?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"You were always by my side. It's because 
it's you, Cheval-chi—that's why I love 
you."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—...And that's why Cheval and I are 
entering the Japan Cup together!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I see, that's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still, judging from what you've said, you 
haven't gotten your Trainer's permission, 
have you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you weren't listening! It's fine, 
right, Trainie?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's move on to the Japan Cup.
Yeah, let's proceed to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing her other sister is important, but 
there will also be international invitees 
in the race. It will surely be a great 
experience for Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I can't wait, Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Cheva-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Why... why do you have to go and say 
everything out loud... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Papa, we would've loved to hear it 
too. Cheval-chan's cool declaration of war 
♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, I'm sure she was so very brave! 
Uuugh, every single one of our girls is 
simply wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it... I knew it would turn out 
like this...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because Cheval-chi was seriously so 
cool~~♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Totally~. Cheval-chan takes after 
her dad, she's so cool ♡"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Verxina and Vivlos really take after their 
mom! ♡ Alright! Tonight we celebrate! A 
toast to Cheval finally speaking her mind!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine once in a while, isn't it? 
We're going to lean down during summer 
training camp anyway, so..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you have them prepare plenty of 
your favorite meat buns?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... ............One is enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughter of a family echoed across the 
evening sky. Surrounded by that cozy 
atmosphere overflowing with mutual love, I 
couldn't help but—
choice_data_list:
You all will be together for a long time 
to come, won't you.

You two will be together for a long time 
to come, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Sorry, everyone! Can you go on ahead?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kins... there's somewhere I kind 
of want to go with you!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Waaah, so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos led me to an observation deck. 
Night had fully fallen, and a dazzling 
city view stretched out below us.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right! The view in Dubai looked just like 
this, too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I remember now. Why I came to love 
Dubai so much."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's busy now, but... back then, our 
family was always together.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Every day brought so much joy, I loved it 
so much! The scenery looked so dazzling 
because... it was definitely because I saw 
it together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Twinkle Series, and being 
together with everyone again... I'm just 
so happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to return to that scenery that 
gave me all those memories!"
choice_data_list:
So next time, you're the one leading 
everyone.

So next time, you're the one leading 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah.
choice_data_list:
Let's go to Dubai again with the whole 
family.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, that goes for you too, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And you're included in that family, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah—! You really didn't understand at all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Japan Cup.' I'll take 1st place, 
and then—"
